name: Waldemar Prinski
backstory: Prinski worked heavily with Enver Gortash in creating the Motivators to control the Gondians, and was instrumental in creating the Iron Throne alongside a rogue member of the Church of Umberlee, Dark Breaker Antiope who handled and controlled the Sahuagin. At some point, he likely ran afoul of Gortash, as he is found dead in the Iron Throne soon after.
